title: Bifrost Command Policy
description: Deny-by-default command authorization policy-as-code. Language-neutral — any consumer can validate a policy document against this schema without depending on Bifrost code.

rules.description: Ordered authorization rules; each rule is an implicit-allow candidate matched by principal/target/command.

default.description: Effect applied when no rule matches. Deny-by-default is the invariant: this must always be "deny".

principal.description: Requesting principal (e.g. an HMI/SCADA identity) this rule authorizes.

constraint.description: Value-domain constraint on the command payload, or null for a trigger-only rule (only value=true is permitted).

target.description: Command target. device is null for node-level commands. Wildcards ("*") are supported in group and edge.

constraint.description: Value domain constraint. type is MetricDataType.toString() (e.g. "Double"). min/max are each optional; null means unbounded. Bounds are inclusive.
